messages.content: I keep ordering one more coffee every morning, does anyone else live this?

It seems like there's a tension forming around coffee. As seen in tensions/coffee-addiction.md, "I am addicted to coffee. I said I wasn't going to order it, but now it's getting to it and I'm pretty sure I'm going to order it." Does this resonate with you? Is there a sense of lobha (greed, pulling) towards coffee that you're experiencing?
